abort / limit hit = not sustained within registered limits, with the exact limit and state recorded
ignition / start attempts recorded, incl. ICP ignition, Hall ignition with ICP electrons, restart success and cycle count, classified per the preregistration
two elevated background-pressure levels for facility-effect characterization; T-PB-MAX frozen only after the knee and facility capability are known

matched sham service lines in every compared configuration
the actual Vyovrinda H-1 is the scored article; surrogate hardware only as non-scoring shakedown

facility radiative sink temperature measured per run
